operating_income.source: Walmart 10-K FY2026, acc. 0000104169-26-000055, consolidated results of operations

d_and_a.source: 10-K FY2026 acc. 0000104169-26-000055: cash flow statement D&A FY2026 14,203, FY2025 12,973; FY2024 given only as $11.9bn in PP&E note (rounded)

capex.source: 10-K FY2026 acc. 0000104169-26-000055, cash flow statement, payments for property and equipment

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY27 company guidance net sales cc +3.5% to +4.5% (Q4 FY26 earnings release); FY24-26 reported growth 6.0%/5.1%/4.7%; fade toward ~3.5% as base grows

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY26 4.2%, FY25 4.4%, FY24 4.2% (10-K); FY27 guidance of adj. op income +6-8% vs sales +3.5-4.5% implies modest expansion; hold 4.3% flat

tax_rate.source: Assumption: effective rate 23.4% FY25, 25.5% FY24 (10-K FY2025); mid-point ~24.5%

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY26 capex/revenue 3.74%, FY25 3.49%; elevated investment in automation/supply chain, slight moderation

wacc.source: Assumption: low-beta mega-cap retailer (beta ~0.6-0.7), rf ~4.2%, ERP ~5% => cost of equity ~7.5-8%, low debt weight at ~4.5% after-tax cost; ~7.5%. Not from a data provider

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run nominal GDP/inflation, below WACC

net_debt.source: 10-K FY2026 acc. 0000104169-26-000055 balance sheet 1/31/2026: short-term borrowings 6,596 + LTD due within one year 3,542 + LTD 34,624 = 44,762, less cash 10,727; leases excluded; no short-term investments reported

diluted_shares.source: 10-K FY2026 EPS note: weighted-average diluted shares FY2026, 8,022 million
